# golang.org/issue/29591: 'go get' was following plain-HTTP redirects even without -insecure (now replaced by GKINSECURE).

[!git] skip

env GKPROXY=direct
env GKSUMDB=off

! go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest
stderr 'redirected .* to insecure URL'

# insecure host
env GKINSECURE=vcs-test.golang.org
go clean -modcache
go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# insecure glob host
env GKINSECURE=*.golang.org
go clean -modcache
go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# insecure multiple host
env GKINSECURE=somewhere-else.com,*.golang.org
go clean -modcache
go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest

# different insecure host does not fetch
env GKINSECURE=somewhere-else.com
go clean -modcache
! go mod download vcs-test.golang.org/insecure/go/insecure@latest
stderr 'redirected .* to insecure URL'
